# Ayush Kashyap — Full-stack Software Engineer · Web, Mobile & AI

> Full-stack software engineer who ships production systems end to end — web, mobile and AI —
> and makes complicated systems simple: to use, to ship, to scale. Writing code since 9th grade;
> 4+ years professional (from Mar 2022: Intern → SDE → SDE II (Tech Lead); 3+ years full-time;
> leads the dev team), plus freelance and part-time client work before that. His flagship work
> is in healthcare: he is the #1 all-time contributor to the core frontend of a multi-tenant,
> white-label EHR/SaaS (web + iOS/Android on AWS) and one of the principal contributors to the
> core platform. It serves 2,000+ active clinics, thousands of doctors, and hundreds of thousands
> of patients across 100+ specialties, processing tens of thousands of appointments a month.
> Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Dart · React, Next.js, React Native, Flutter · Node.js,
> Express, Flask, Socket.io, Redis · MySQL, PostgreSQL · AWS (ECS, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, Polly,
> Translate) · LLM integration, speech-to-text · FHIR R4/HL7/ABDM.
> Open to software engineering roles (full-stack, backend, mobile, AI application).
> Based in Indore, India · open to relocating anywhere in India, or remote · available immediately.

## Highlights
- Architected and operates a multi-tenant healthtech EHR platform: one product serving 2,000+ active clinics, thousands of doctors, and hundreds of thousands of patients across 100+ specialties, with per-tenant isolation and a white-label layer of dozens of custom-branded deployments — no per-client forks.
- Implemented FHIR R4 / HL7 interoperability for India's National Digital Health Mission (NDHM / ABDM).
- Leads the clinical-AI and speech work (Python): an AI medical scribe, live with a pilot group of clinicians (some AI features in production); led the team's speech-model (Whisper) fine-tuning.
- Shipped clinician + patient apps (React Native) live on the App Store & Play Store — Hermes, Fastlane, OTA updates.
- Tech lead: consolidated the repositories into one GitHub organisation, set up automatic deployment on every merge across the platform, AWS cost-optimisation, and a major React Native upgrade.
- Open source: fhir-notecheck — https://github.com/ayushk01/fhir-notecheck
- Built Letsdrive end to end, solo (independent client project, 2024–25) — a carpooling + peer-to-peer car-rental marketplace across three codebases (Flutter mobile, TypeScript/Express/Prisma backend with a 13-model schema, Next.js admin).
